sources.excerpt: Orwell dystopia (1949). Set in a fictional future London; Britain is now Airstrip One after decades of war and revolution. Protagonist Winston Smith, 39, rewrites records at the Ministry of Truth and secretly opposes the Party. Themes: totalitarianism, surveillance, truth.

sources.excerpt: Korean title 1984 (translations also 1984년). Forbidden affair with Julia; arrest and long torture at the Ministry of Love. Described as Orwell's least witty book. Class structure of Oceania. Films 1956 and 1984.
